name: FlightSearchWidget
description: The flight search form: trip type, From / To with swap, dates, passengers and cabin, and the Search flights button. Used in the home hero and the "Modify search" overlay on results.

evidence: Props, composition and responsive layouts documented; no dedicated states or accessibility section (inherits from its parts).

provenance.tag: A · unverified (search widget not captured from the live site)

props.name: layout
props.description: bar on lg+, stacked on md, overlay (full screen) on sm.

interaction: Trip type drives which fields show: one-way uses DateField single, return uses range.
Multi-city repeats the From / To / Date row for each journey. The journey limit comes from config.
Swap button (⇄) between From and To: Button variant="secondary" size="sm" with icon arrows-left-right (A · unverified).

responsive.behavior: Collapses to a single "Search flights" field that opens a full-screen overlay.

rules: Trip-type control → fields gap --space-4. Gap between fields --space-2 on desktop (one bar) and --space-3 on mobile (stacked).
In the home hero it sits in a Card with --elevation-3, overlapping the bottom of the hero.
Search button: Button variant="primary" size="lg" ("Search flights"); fields use TextField size lg so they line up (D23).
